name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Putin met US envoys 12 Nov; 123 drones overnight
summary: US envoys met Putin on 12 Nov with no ceasefire; Russia fired missiles and 123 drones at Ukraine the night before
state: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met President Putin in the Kremlin for about two hours on 12 Nov, after Abu Dhabi talks yielded a prisoner-swap deal but no ceasefire; Putin said European troops in Ukraine after a ceasefire would be a legitimate target (AP). Overnight on 11–12 Nov Russia launched missiles and 123 drones, with hits at 17 locations (Ukrainska Pravda). The IAEA said a drone killed a Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant worker on 9 Nov (The Moscow Times). That nuclear-safety incident keeps the Alert.
for_you: Talks continue without a ceasefire. Strikes on Ukraine's energy system disrupt heat, power and water. Anyone in or travelling to Ukraine should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Alert: nuclear-plant safety incident (Zaporizhzhia worker killed by drone, 9 Nov) amid sustained mass strikes
